exposure: barriers at community level (no prenatal care, lack of trust, lack of recognition of disease severity, attribution of symptoms to something else)
barriers at primary health system level
barriers at hospital level (fear of staff of being infected, non-compliance with guidelines, lack of team working, problem with telehealth)
cohort: The study included 12 cases of maternal deaths attributed to COVID-19 in the southeast of Iran identified through the Iranian Maternal Mortality Surveillance System from March 2020 to March 2021.
finding: The socio-cultural context, unmet healthcare needs, and various systemic healthcare factors (including issues with telehealth) were identified as significant barriers preventing timely healthcare utilization, detection, and referral for quality services among women with COVID-19, contributing to maternal deaths.
